jars: the phrase 'a panic attack, not a hero'
'you cannot forgive the fear that it is who you really are'
'the only way forward is to do the one thing that is in front of you. Walk to your child and say you are sorry.'
best: At work, you manage twelve people with a steady hand. At home, the same mind has no door to close. Let the shaking be the truth of the morning, not a sentence on your character.
day1_verdict: This actually named the shaking in my hands and the replay of my mother's voice, which is exactly why I opened the app.
